<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Promeet — Preview</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;0,900;1,500;1,600;1,700;1,800&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500;1,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
        html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none;}
        html::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
        body::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
  section[id]{scroll-margin-top:100px;}
  :root{
    --bg-deep:#ffffff;
    --bg-mid:#f7f5fb;
    --bg-mid2:#f0ecf9;
    --purple:#7c3aed;
    --orange:#ff6a00;
    --pink:#ec4899;
    --blue:#4f6df5;
    --teal:#0d9488;
    --amber:#d97706;
    --green:#059669;
    --text:#221a35;
    --text-dim:#6b6480;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--bg-deep);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  }
  .note{
    background:#f0ecf9;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    font-size:14px;
    text-align:center;
    padding:10px 16px;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }
  .container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;width:100%;}

  /* Header */
  header{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:12px 40px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:var(--bg-deep);
  }
  .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:18px;}
  .logo span{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .logoDot{width:40px;height:40px;object-fit:contain;display:block;}
  nav{display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:16px;color:var(--text-dim);}
   nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
   nav a:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .headerAuth{display:flex;gap:12px;}
  .btnSignin{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;position:relative;}
  .btnSignin::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:10px;padding:2px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask-composite:exclude;pointer-events:none;}
  .btnSignup{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;}

  /* ── Full-screen sections ──────────────────────────── */
  section{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
  section.ctaSection,section.pricingSection,section.testimonialsSection,
  section.faqSection,section.getStarted{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
  header,.footer{min-height:auto;display:flex;}
  .footer{display:block;}

  /* Hero */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;padding:0 24px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1150 0%,#1c1330 55%,#170e28 100%);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:calc(100vh - 65px);}
  .hero .heroGlow{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);pointer-events:none;animation:blobFloat 11s ease-in-out infinite;}
  .hero .heroGlow1{width:360px;height:360px;top:-120px;left:-100px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,106,0,0.4),transparent 70%);}
  .hero .heroGlow2{width:400px;height:400px;bottom:-150px;right:-110px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(124,58,237,0.4),transparent 70%);animation-duration:14s;animation-delay:-4s;}
  @keyframes blobFloat{
    0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1);}
    50%{transform:translate(30px,-26px) scale(1.1);}
  }



  @keyframes heroFadeUp{
    from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);}
    to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
  }
  .hero .heroBrandBlock,
  .hero .heroPill,
  .hero h2,
  .hero > p,
  .hero .heroButtons{
    animation:heroFadeUp .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;
  }
  .hero .heroBrandBlock{animation-delay:.05s;}
  .hero .heroPill{animation-delay:.18s;}
  .hero h2{animation-delay:.32s;}
  .hero > p{animation-delay:.46s;}
  .hero .heroButtons{animation-delay:.6s;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .hero .heroGlow,.hero .heroBrandBlock,.hero .heroPill,.hero h2,.hero > p,.hero .heroButtons{animation:none !important;opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important;}
  }
  .hero p.heroBrandLabel{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;color:#c9bfe8;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin:0 auto 6px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}
  .hero .heroBrandLine{width:38px;height:1px;background:rgba(201,191,232,0.45);}
  .hero h1{font-size:104px;margin:0 0 18px;letter-spacing:-3px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,var(--orange) 20%,var(--pink) 40%,#ffb199 50%,var(--pink) 60%,var(--orange) 80%);background-size:250% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 30px rgba(255,106,0,0.35));animation:titleShimmer 6s linear infinite 1s;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;}
  @keyframes titleShimmer{
    0%{background-position:200% 0;}
    100%{background-position:-50% 0;}
  }
  .hero h2{font-size:42px;color:var(--orange);font-weight:700;margin:0 0 20px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-0.5px;}
  .hero p{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 30px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);line-height:1.6;font-size:19px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;}
  .heroButtons{display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;}
  .btnPrimary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));color:#fff;text-decoration:none;padding:16px 36px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;transition:transform 0.25s ease,box-shadow 0.25s ease;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(255,106,0,0.22);}
  .btnPrimary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(255,106,0,0.35);}
  .btnSecondary{border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;padding:16px 36px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;transition:transform 0.25s ease,background 0.25s ease,border-color 0.25s ease;}
  .btnSecondary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .hero .btnSecondary{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);color:#fff;}
  .hero .btnSecondary:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.55);}
  .hero .heroBrandBlock{margin:0 0 4px;}
  .hero .heroPill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:rgba(255,106,0,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,106,0,0.35);border-radius:100px;padding:8px 22px 8px 16px;margin:0 0 22px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);}
  .hero .pillIcon{font-size:14px;line-height:1;}
  .hero .pillText{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#ffab6b;text-transform:uppercase;}

  /* Dashboard glass */
  .dashboardGlass{padding:50px 24px 30px;}
  .dashboardGlass .container{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;width:100%;}
  .dashboardCards{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:stretch;
    background:#faf9fd;
    border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(124,58,237,0.08);
    border-radius:26px;padding:28px;width:100%;
  }
  .dashCard{border-radius:16px;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-height:190px;}
  .dashboardBottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px;margin-top:22px;width:100%;}
  .dashCard.live{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),#ff8c42);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);color:#fff;}
  .liveTop{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .liveTop h3{margin:0;font-size:19px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#fff;}
  .titleIcon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:30px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.2);border-radius:8px;}
  .liveBadge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.5px;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.22);color:#fff;}
  .liveDot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;animation:dashPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes dashPulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.8);}}
  .liveStats{display:flex;align-items:center;}
  .stat h2{margin:0;font-size:42px;color:#fff;}
  .stat p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);}
  .statDivider{width:1px;align-self:stretch;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.3);margin:4px 24px;}

  .dashCard.visitStatus{background:#fff;color:var(--text);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);}
  .visitStatusHead h3{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);}
  .visitStatusHead p{margin:2px 0 14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .visitStatusBody{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;}
  .donutWrap{position:relative;width:110px;height:110px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .donutWrap svg{display:block;}
  .donutCenter{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .donutCenter strong{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);line-height:1;}
  .donutCenter span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;margin-top:3px;}
  .visitLegend{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:0;}
  .visitLegendRow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:13px;}
  .visitLegendLeft{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}
  .visitDot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
  .visitLegendRight{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .visitCount{font-weight:800;color:var(--purple);font-size:14px;}
  .visitPct{background:#f0ecf9;color:var(--purple);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;}
  .visitBar{display:flex;height:8px;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:16px;}
  .visitBar .segGray{background:#6b6480;flex:1;}
  .visitBar .segPurple{background:var(--purple);flex:1;}

  .dashCard.meeting{background:#fff;color:#221a35;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);}
  .dashCard.meeting.peakHours{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
  .peakHead h3{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);}
  .peakHead p{margin:2px 0 18px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .peakBars{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:90px;}
  .peakBars span{flex:1;background:#ece7fa;border-radius:6px 6px 3px 3px;min-height:14px;}
  .peakBars span.peakMed{background:#a78bfa;}
  .peakBars span.peak{background:#7c3aed;}
  .peakLabels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;}

  .meetingHead{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .meetingHead .icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#a78bfa);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:18px;}
  .meetingHead h3{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--text);}
  .meetingHead p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .bars{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .bars span{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:#eee6f7;}
  .bars .fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#22c55e,#16a34a);flex:2;}
  .chartGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .chartIcon{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;padding:10px 4px;border-radius:10px;background:#f7f5fb;transition:transform 0.2s,background 0.2s;cursor:pointer;}
  .chartIcon:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#f0ecf9;}
  .chartIcon svg{width:22px;height:22px;display:block;}
  .chartIcon span{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;}
  .meetingStatus{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .meetingStatus strong{color:#16a34a;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;}
  .dashCol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;}

  /* Visitor Pass Card inside dashboard */
  .vpCard{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg-mid),var(--bg-mid2));border-radius:16px;padding:20px;color:var(--text);position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(124,58,237,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-height:190px;}
  #vpCardPreview .vpWaBanner{display:none;}
  .vpCardHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .vpCardHeaderLeft{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;}
  .vpDot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);flex-shrink:0;}
  .vpCardHeader small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:var(--purple);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;}
  .vpCardId{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;color:var(--purple);letter-spacing:0.2px;}
  .vpCardTop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .vpCardDetails{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  .vpDetailRow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);font-size:12px;}
  .vpDetailRow:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .vpLabel{color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;font-size:10px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .vpValue{color:var(--text);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;text-align:right;word-break:break-word;}
  .vpValue.status-active{color:var(--green);}
  .vpValue.status-out{color:#dc2626;}
  .vpAvatar{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#a78bfa);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(124,58,237,0.3);}
  .vpAvatar svg{width:22px;height:22px;}
  .vpWaBanner{margin-top:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(16,185,129,0.14),rgba(5,150,105,0.2));border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .vpWaBannerLeft{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
  .vpWaBannerIcon{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#fff;}
  .vpWaBannerIcon img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
  .vpWaBannerText strong{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--text);}
  .vpWaBannerText span{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .vpWaBannerBtn{background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:none;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;}
  .msgIntimate{background:rgba(255,106,0,0.12);border-left:3px solid var(--orange);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:8px 0;}
  .msgIntimate strong{color:var(--text);}

  /* Form inside dashboard */
  .vpForm{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:22px;text-align:left;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);}
  .vpForm h3{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:17px;color:var(--text);text-align:center;}
  .vpForm .formGroup{margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
  .vpForm .formGroup.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
  .vpForm label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;}
  .vpForm input{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);background:#faf9fd;transition:border-color 0.2s;outline:none;}
  .vpForm input:focus{border-color:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,0.1);}
  .vpForm .vpBtn{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));color:#fff;border:none;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 0.2s,box-shadow 0.2s;margin-top:4px;}
  .vpForm .vpBtn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(255,106,0,0.2);}

  .dashMsgRow{max-width:1200px;margin:16px auto 0;width:100%;}

  /* WhatsApp Phone Mockup */
  .waPhone{background:#0b141a;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);}
  .waHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;background:#1f2c33;color:#e9edef;}
  .waBack{font-size:20px;color:#e9edef;line-height:1;}
  .waCount{font-size:14px;color:#8696a0;padding-left:4px;}
  .waAvatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#2a3942;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
  .waAvatar svg{width:20px;height:20px;}
  .waHeaderText{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .waHeaderText .name{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#e9edef;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .waHeaderText .handle{font-size:12px;color:#25d366;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .waBody{padding:18px 14px 14px;}
  .waBubble{background:#1f2c33;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 14px 8px;color:#e9edef;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;}
  .waBubble .title{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#e9edef;}
  .waBubble p{margin:0 0 12px;color:#e9edef;}
  .waBubble .link{display:block;color:#25d366;text-decoration:underline;word-break:break-all;margin:0 0 12px;}
  .waBubble .details{margin:0 0 12px;}
  .waBubble .details div{margin-bottom:2px;}
  .waBubble .footer{font-size:12px;color:#8696a0;margin:6px 0 4px;}
  .waBubble .timestamp{text-align:right;font-size:11px;color:#8696a0;margin-top:2px;}

  @media (max-width:860px){
    .dashboardCards{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }

  /* Why section / 3D carousel */
  .whySection{padding:40px 0;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1150 0%,#1c1330 55%,#170e28 100%);}
  .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);color:#e0d4ff;font-size:14px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .whySection h2{font-size:48px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#fff;}
  .whySection h2 span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .subheading{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);margin:0 0 24px;font-size:18px;}
  .carousel3D{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;height:56vh;min-height:380px;max-height:480px;perspective:1400px;}
  .carouselStage{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;transform-style:preserve-3d;}
  .card{
    position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;width:420px;height:auto;min-height:240px;margin-left:-210px;
    text-align:left;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
    box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);border-radius:18px;padding:32px 28px;
    box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    transition:transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity 0.7s ease,box-shadow 0.4s ease;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .card.pos-0{transform:translateX(0) translateZ(0) rotateY(0deg) scale(1);opacity:1;z-index:6;box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);}
  .card.pos-0:hover{box-shadow:0 28px 56px rgba(124,58,237,0.4);}
  .card.pos--1{transform:translateX(-340px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(32deg) scale(0.82);opacity:0.75;z-index:5;}
  .card.pos-1{transform:translateX(340px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-32deg) scale(0.82);opacity:0.75;z-index:5;}
  .card.pos--2{transform:translateX(-540px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(40deg) scale(0.64);opacity:0.35;z-index:4;}
  .card.pos-2{transform:translateX(540px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-40deg) scale(0.64);opacity:0.35;z-index:4;}
  .card.pos-hidden{transform:translateX(0) translateZ(-500px) scale(0.5);opacity:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;}
  .iconContainer{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .iconContainer.purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#a78bfa);}
  .iconContainer.orange{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),#ff8c42);}
  .iconContainer.blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),#8fa3ff);}
  .iconContainer.teal{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),#2dd4bf);}
  .iconContainer.amber{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--amber),#fbbf24);}
  .iconContainer.green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),#34d399);}
  .card.purple{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#a78bfa 0%,#7c3aed 100%);border-color:#7c3aed;}
  .card.orange{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fb923c 0%,#ea580c 100%);border-color:#ea580c;}
  .card.blue{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#60a5fa 0%,#2563eb 100%);border-color:#2563eb;}
  .card.teal{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#34d399 0%,#0d9488 100%);border-color:#0d9488;}
  .card.amber{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbbf24 0%,#d97706 100%);border-color:#d97706;}
  .card.green{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#4ade80 0%,#16a34a 100%);border-color:#16a34a;}
  .card.purple,.card.orange,.card.blue,.card.teal,.card.amber,.card.green{color:#fff;}
  .card.purple h3,.card.orange h3,.card.blue h3,.card.teal h3,.card.amber h3,.card.green h3,
  .card.purple p,.card.orange p,.card.blue p,.card.teal p,.card.amber p,.card.green p{color:#fff;}
  .card h3{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--text);}
  .card p{font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;margin:0;}
  .carouselDots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:16px;}
  .carouselDot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.25);border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:background 0.25s ease,transform 0.25s ease;}
  .carouselDot.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));transform:scale(1.3);}
  .carouselArrow{
    position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:20;
    width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(4px);transition:background 0.2s ease,transform 0.2s ease;
  }
  .carouselArrow:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.22);transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1.08);}
  .carouselArrow.left{left:10px;}
  .carouselArrow.right{right:10px;}

  /* How it works */
  .howItWorks{padding:40px 0;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg-mid) 0%, var(--bg-mid2) 100%);}
  .howItWorks .title,.everythingSection .title{font-size:46px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--text);}
  .howItWorks .title span,.everythingSection .title span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .subtitle{color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 0 22px;font-size:18px;}
  .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .stepCard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,20,60,0.05);border-radius:18px;padding:28px 22px;position:relative;text-align:left;transition:transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow 0.28s ease,border-color 0.28s ease;cursor:pointer;}
  .stepCard:hover{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 20px 34px rgba(124,58,237,0.18);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,0.35);}
  .stepCard .icon{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;transition:transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);}
  .stepCard:hover .icon{transform:scale(1.15) rotate(-6deg);}
  .icon.orange{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),#ff8c42);}
  .icon.purple{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#a78bfa);}
  .icon.blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#60a5fa);}
  .icon.pink{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),#f472b6);}
  .stepNo{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(0,0,0,0.06);}
  .stepCard h3{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--text);transition:color 0.28s ease;}
  .stepCard:hover h3{color:#7c3aed;}
  .stepCard p{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0;line-height:1.6;}
  .ctaText{color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 0 12px;font-size:15px;}
  .ctaBtn{display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));color:#fff;text-decoration:none;padding:14px 30px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;}

  /* Everything section */
  .everythingSection{padding:40px 0;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1150 0%,#1c1330 55%,#170e28 100%);}
  .everythingSection .title{color:#fff;}
  .featuresGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .featureBox{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,20,60,0.05);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;font-size:14px;text-align:left;color:var(--text-dim);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;transition:transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 0.28s ease,border-color 0.28s ease;will-change:transform;}
  .featureBox:hover{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.035);box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(124,58,237,0.22);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,0.35);z-index:2;}
  .featureTick{flex-shrink:0;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16a34a,#4ade80);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);}
  .featureBox:hover .featureTick{transform:rotate(360deg) scale(1.2);}
  .everythingSection .subtitle{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);margin:0 0 18px;}

  @media (max-width:900px){
    .dashboardCards{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .steps,.featuresGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    nav{display:none;}
    .dashboardBottom{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .combinedInner{flex-direction:column;min-height:auto;}
    .combinedCta,.combinedSecurity{flex:1 1 100%;}
    .combinedDivider{width:100%;height:1px;}
    .gsContainer{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .pricingCards,.testimonialCards,.securityCards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .footerTop{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .industryGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  }

  /* Moving grid background — tinted per section so the bifurcation is visible */
  .gridBg{
    position:relative;
    isolation:isolate;
  }
  .gridBg::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    z-index:0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:44px 44px;
    animation:gridMove 14s linear infinite;
    opacity:0.75;
  }
  .gridBg::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    z-index:0;
    background:var(--grid-wash);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .gridBg > *{
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
  }
  @keyframes gridMove{
    from{background-position:0 0, 0 0;}
    to{background-position:44px 44px, 44px 44px;}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .gridBg::before{animation:none;}
  }

  /* The fine grid lines use ONE constant color across every light section —
     only the soft background wash shifts. This is what removes the visible
     seam at section boundaries: the lines never change color, so nothing
     "cuts" at the border, only a gentle color wave underneath.
     Wash colors stay within the brand palette only (orange / rose / pink /
     purple) moving in one direction each step, so no jump ever spans more
     than one hue-neighbor. */
  .gridBg{
    --grid-line: rgba(124,58,237,0.16);
  }
  .footer.gridBg{
    --grid-line: rgba(124,58,237,0.16);
  }
  .hero.gridBg{
    --grid-line: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  }


  .whySection.gridBg,
  .everythingSection.gridBg,
  .ctaSection.gridBg,
  .testimonialsSection.gridBg,
  .getStarted.gridBg{
    --grid-line: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  }

  .hero.gridBg, .dashboardGlass.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,106,0,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(244,63,131,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(255,106,0,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .whySection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,106,0,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(236,72,153,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, rgba(244,63,131,0.08), transparent 60%);
  }
  .howItWorks.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(244,63,131,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(124,58,237,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(236,72,153,0.08), transparent 60%);
  }
  .everythingSection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236,72,153,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(236,72,153,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%, rgba(124,58,237,0.08), transparent 60%);
  }
  .industriesSection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(244,63,131,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(236,72,153,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .combinedSection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(244,63,131,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(236,72,153,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .pricingSection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236,72,153,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(255,106,0,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(244,63,131,0.06), transparent 60%);
  }
  .testimonialsSection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,106,0,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(236,72,153,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%, rgba(124,58,237,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .getStarted.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(236,72,153,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(124,58,237,0.09) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%, rgba(244,63,131,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .faqSection.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(124,58,237,0.13) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(236,72,153,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .footer.gridBg{
    --grid-wash:
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.09) 0%, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, rgba(124,58,237,0.11) 100%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(236,72,153,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }

  /* Industries */
  .industriesSection{padding:40px 0;text-align:center;background:var(--bg-mid);}
  .industryBadge{display:inline-flex;background:rgba(255,106,0,0.1);color:#c2410c;font-size:14px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .industryTitle{font-size:46px;margin:0 0 10px;}
  .industryTitle span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .industrySubtitle{color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 0 24px;font-size:18px;}
  .industryGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;}
  .industryCard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,20,60,0.05);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;text-align:left;transition:transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow 0.28s ease,border-color 0.28s ease;cursor:pointer;}
  .industryCard:hover{transform:translateY(-8px) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 20px 34px rgba(124,58,237,0.18);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,0.35);}
  .industryIcon{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;transition:transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);}
  .industryCard:hover .industryIcon{transform:scale(1.15) rotate(-6deg);}
  .industryIcon.blue{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#60a5fa);}
  .industryIcon.violet{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#a78bfa);}
  .industryIcon.green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16a34a,#4ade80);}
  .industryIcon.amber{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#fbbf24);}
  .industryIcon.red{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#f87171);}
  .industryIcon.sky{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0284c7,#38bdf8);}
  .industryCard h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:18px;transition:color 0.28s ease;}
  .industryCard:hover h3{color:#7c3aed;}
  .industryCard p{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.6;}

  /* CTA Banner */
  .combinedSection{padding:40px 24px;background:var(--bg-deep);}
  .combinedInner{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;min-height:480px;}
  .combinedCta{flex:0 0 calc(40% - 16px);text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));border-radius:28px;padding:50px 44px;color:#fff;}
  .combinedCta h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:36px;}
  .combinedCta p{margin:0 0 20px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);font-size:17px;}
  .combinedCta .ctaActions{margin-bottom:0;}
  .combinedCta .ctaActions .btnPrimary{background:#fff;color:var(--orange);}
  .combinedCta .ctaPoints{margin-top:20px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:15px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);}
  .combinedDivider{width:1px;height:260px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);flex-shrink:0;}
  .combinedSecurity{flex:0 0 calc(60% - 16px);text-align:center;}
  .combinedSecurity h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:36px;color:var(--text);}
  .combinedSecurity > p{margin:0 0 24px;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:17px;}
  .combinedSecurity .securityCards{max-width:100%;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .combinedSecurity .securityCard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,20,60,0.05);padding:24px 16px;}
  .combinedSecurity .securityCard h3{color:var(--text);}
  .combinedSecurity .securityCard p{color:var(--text-dim);}
  .combinedSecurity .barItem p{color:var(--text-dim);}
  .combinedSecurity .barItem h3{color:var(--text);}
  .combinedSecurity .securityBar{background:#fff;border-color:rgba(0,0,0,0.07);}

  /* Pricing */
  .pricingSection{padding:40px 24px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1150 0%,#1c1330 55%,#170e28 100%);}
  .pricingBadge{display:inline-flex;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);color:#e0d4ff;font-size:14px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .pricingTitle{font-size:46px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#fff;}
  .pricingSubtitle{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);max-width:700px;margin:0 auto 22px;font-size:18px;}
  .pricingCards{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;align-items:stretch;padding-top:10px;}
  .pricingCard{
    --plan-accent:#7c3aed;
    background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.14);
    box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(124,58,237,0.08);
    border-radius:22px;padding:36px 28px 28px;text-align:left;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    transition:transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 0.32s ease,border-color 0.32s ease;
    will-change:transform;
  }
  .pricingCard::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:5px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--plan-accent),var(--pink));
    opacity:0.9;
  }
  .pricingCard::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:-60px;right:-60px;width:140px;height:140px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--plan-accent) 0%,transparent 70%);
    opacity:0.08;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity 0.32s ease,transform 0.32s ease;
  }
  .pricingCard:hover{transform:translateY(-14px) scale(1.03);box-shadow:0 30px 54px rgba(124,58,237,0.22);border-color:rgba(124,58,237,0.4);z-index:2;}
  .pricingCard:hover::after{opacity:0.16;transform:scale(1.15);}
  .pricingCard.featured{
    border:2px solid var(--purple);
    box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(124,58,237,0.2);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#faf7ff 0%,#ffffff 100%);
  }
  .pricingCard.featured:hover{transform:translateY(-18px) scale(1.045);box-shadow:0 34px 64px rgba(124,58,237,0.36);border-color:var(--purple);}
  .popularBadge{
    position:absolute;top:20px;right:-34px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));color:#fff;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.3px;padding:6px 44px;
    transform:rotate(40deg);box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(124,58,237,0.35);
    transition:transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .pricingCard.featured:hover .popularBadge{transform:rotate(40deg) scale(1.08);}
  .planIcon{
    width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:18px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--plan-accent),var(--pink));
    box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(124,58,237,0.25);
    transition:transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  }
  .pricingCard:hover .planIcon{transform:rotate(-6deg) scale(1.1);}
  .planName{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:16px;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.6px;font-weight:700;}
  .planPrice{font-size:48px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:-0.5px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--text) 40%,var(--plan-accent) 130%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .planPrice span{font-size:16px;font-weight:400;background:none;-webkit-background-clip:initial;background-clip:initial;color:var(--text-dim);-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--text-dim);}
  .planDuration{font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 0 22px;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);}
  .planFeatures{list-style:none;margin:0 0 24px;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;font-size:15px;color:var(--text);flex:1;}
  .planFeatures li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
  .checkIcon{
    flex-shrink:0;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#16a34a,#4ade80);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .planCta{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--bg-mid);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;transition:transform 0.25s ease,box-shadow 0.25s ease,background 0.25s ease;}
  .pricingCard:hover .planCta{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(124,58,237,0.18);}
  .pricingCard.featured .planCta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));color:#fff;}
  .pricingCard.featured:hover .planCta{box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(124,58,237,0.4);}


  /* Testimonials */
  .testimonialsSection{padding:40px 24px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1150 0%,#1c1330 55%,#170e28 100%);}
  .sectionBadge{display:inline-flex;background:rgba(255,106,0,0.1);color:#c2410c;font-size:14px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .sectionTitle{font-size:46px;margin:0 0 10px;color:#fff;}
  .sectionTitle span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .sectionSubtitle{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);margin:0 0 24px;font-size:18px;}
  .testimonialCards{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;}
  .testimonialCard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,20,60,0.05);border-radius:18px;padding:32px;text-align:left;transition:border-color 0.2s ease;}
  .testimonialCard:hover{border:2px solid var(--purple);padding:31px;}
  .stars{color:#f59e0b;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:16px;}
  .review{font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 20px;}
  .user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
  .avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;}
  .user strong{display:block;font-size:15px;}
  .user span{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .testimonialStats{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;}
  .testimonialStats h3{margin:0;font-size:38px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .testimonialStats p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:15px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);}

  /* Security */
  .securityCards{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px;}
  .securityCard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,20,60,0.05);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 24px;transition:transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow 0.3s ease;will-change:transform;}
  .securityCard:hover{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 22px 40px rgba(35,20,60,0.18);z-index:2;}
  .securityIcon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 16px;transition:transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);}
  .securityCard:hover .securityIcon{transform:rotate(-10deg) scale(1.18);}
  .securityCard h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px;}
  .securityCard p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .securityBar{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;}
  .barItem h3{margin:0;font-size:26px;}
  .barItem p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .divider{width:1px;height:40px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}

  /* FAQ */
  .faqSection{padding:40px 24px;background:var(--bg-deep);}
  .faqContainer{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;width:100%;}
  .faqBadge{display:inline-flex;background:rgba(124,58,237,0.1);color:#7c3aed;font-size:14px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .faqTitle{font-size:42px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--text);}
  .faqTitle span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .faqSubtitle{color:var(--text-dim);margin:0 0 32px;font-size:18px;}
  .faqGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;text-align:left;margin:0 0 28px;}
  .faqCol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;}
  @media (max-width:760px){.faqGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .faqItem{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);border-radius:16px;padding:20px 22px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(35,20,60,0.06);transition:box-shadow 0.25s,transform 0.25s;}
  .faqItem:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(35,20,60,0.1);}
  .faqItemHead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;}
  .faqItemHead h4{margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);line-height:1.4;}
  .faqItemToggle{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;transition:transform 0.25s ease;}
  .faqItem.open .faqItemToggle{transform:rotate(45deg);}
  .faqItemAnswer{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height 0.3s ease;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.65;}
  .faqItemAnswer.open{max-height:220px;margin-top:12px;}
  .faqCta{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.07);border-radius:18px;padding:32px;}
  .faqCta h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:20px;}
  .faqCta p{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);}

  /* Get Started */
  .getStarted{padding:40px 24px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2a1150 0%,#1c1330 55%,#170e28 100%);}
  .gsContainer{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;width:100%;}
  .gsBadge{display:inline-flex;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12);color:#e0d4ff;font-size:14px;padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .gsLeft h2{font-size:40px;margin:0 0 18px;color:#fff;}
  .gsLeft h2 span{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .gsLeft p{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);margin:0 0 28px;line-height:1.7;font-size:18px;}
  .gsContact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;}
  .contactItem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:16px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.65);}
  .contactItem .icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;}
  .contactItem .icon.whatsapp{background:#25D366;}
  .contactItem .icon.email{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),var(--pink));}
  .contactItem strong{color:#fff;}
  .gsRight{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;}
  .gsCard{border-radius:18px;padding:34px;color:#fff;}
  .gsCard.whatsappCard{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#25D366,#1ea952);}
  .gsCard.demoCard{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--purple),#5b21b6);}
  .gsCard h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:22px;}
  .gsCard p{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:15px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.88);}
  .gsCard .btn{display:inline-block;background:#fff;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;}
  .gsCard .btn.secondary{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);color:#fff;}

  /* Footer */
  .footer{background:var(--bg-deep);color:var(--text);padding:48px 24px 28px;}
  .footerTop{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr;gap:48px;padding-bottom:36px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}
  .logoWrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .logoWrap h3{margin:0;font-size:19px;}
  .logoWrap span{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .footerBrand p{font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 22px;}
  .footerCta{display:flex;gap:14px;}
  .btnPrimary.footer, .footerCta .btnPrimary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));color:#fff;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;}
  .footerCta .btnSecondary{border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;}
  .footerLinks h4{font-size:17px;margin:0 0 18px;}
  .footerLinks ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;font-size:15px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .footerTrust{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;gap:22px;padding:32px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .trustCard{flex:1;min-width:220px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(35,20,60,0.06),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);}
  .trustCard strong{display:block;font-size:17px;}
  .trustCard span{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .footerBottom{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);padding-top:24px;}

  /* Footer */
  .footer{background:var(--bg-deep);color:var(--text);padding:40px 24px 24px;}
  .footerTop{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;padding-bottom:32px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}
  .logoWrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .logoWrap h3{margin:0;font-size:17px;}
  .logoWrap span{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .footerBrand p{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 18px;}
  .footerCta{display:flex;gap:12px;}
  .btnPrimary.footer, .footerCta .btnPrimary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));color:#fff;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;}
  .footerCta .btnSecondary{border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;}
  .footerLinks h4{font-size:16px;margin:0 0 16px;}
  .footerLinks ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .footerTrust{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;gap:18px;padding:28px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .trustCard{flex:1;min-width:200px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(35,20,60,0.06),0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);}
  .trustCard strong{display:block;font-size:16px;}
  .trustCard span{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);}
  .footerBottom{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-dim);padding-top:20px;}
  .footerBottom a{color:#8f87a8;text-decoration:none;margin-left:16px;}
  .footerLinksInline a:first-child{margin-left:0;}

  @media (max-width:900px){
    .industryGrid,.pricingCards,.testimonialCards,.securityCards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .gsContainer,.footerTop{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }

  /* Floating WhatsApp */
  .floatingWhatsapp{
    position:fixed;bottom:30px;right:30px;width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(37,211,102,0.45);
    text-decoration:none;z-index:999;
  }
  .waPulse{
    position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:#25D366;
    animation:waPulseAnim 2.2s ease-out infinite;z-index:0;
  }
  .waPulse2{animation-delay:1.1s;}
  @keyframes waPulseAnim{
    0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:0.55;}
    100%{transform:scale(1.9);opacity:0;}
  }
  .waIconWrap{
    position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;
    overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .waIcon{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .waIconImg{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .waTooltip{
    position:absolute;right:70px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(8px);
    background:#1c1330;color:#fff;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;
    white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity 0.25s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
  }
  .waTooltip::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:100%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
    border:6px solid transparent;border-left-color:#1c1330;
  }
  .waTooltipVisible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-50%) translateX(0);}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .waPulse{animation:none;}
  }

  /* ── Responsive Enhancements ───────────────────────── */
  .hamburger{display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:8px;z-index:200;}
  .hamburger span{width:26px;height:3px;background:var(--text);border-radius:3px;transition:0.3s;}
  .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(45deg) translate(5px,6px);}
  .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2){opacity:0;}
  .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-45deg) translate(5px,-6px);}
  .mobileNav{display:none;}
  .mobileNav.open{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--bg-deep);z-index:150;padding:90px 30px 30px;gap:6px;overflow-y:auto;}
  .mobileNav a{padding:14px 0;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);display:block;}
  .mobileNav a:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--pink));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
  .mobileNav .headerAuth{padding-top:20px;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
  .mobileNav .headerAuth a{text-align:center;display:block;}

  @media (max-width:1200px){
    .hero h1{font-size:clamp(36px, 8vw, 80px);}
    .hero h2{font-size:clamp(20px, 3.5vw, 36px);}
    .whySection h2,.pricingTitle,.sectionTitle,.industryTitle,.howItWorks .title,.everythingSection .title{font-size:clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);}
    .planPrice{font-size:clamp(32px, 4vw, 46px);}
    .card{width:clamp(280px, 38vw, 380px);margin-left:clamp(-140px, -19vw, -190px);}
    .card.pos--1{transform:translateX(clamp(-220px, -28vw, -300px)) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(32deg) scale(0.82);}
    .card.pos-1{transform:translateX(clamp(220px, 28vw, 300px)) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-32deg) scale(0.82);}
    .card.pos--2{transform:translateX(clamp(-380px, -46vw, -480px)) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(40deg) scale(0.64);}
    .card.pos-2{transform:translateX(clamp(380px, 46vw, 480px)) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-40deg) scale(0.64);}
    .combinedInner{min-height:auto;}
    .carousel3D{height:clamp(320px, 50vw, 440px);}
  }

  @media (max-width:1024px){

    .container{padding:0 16px;}
    .hero{padding:0 16px;}
    section{padding:30px 0 !important;}
    .dashboardCards{padding:20px;}
    .dashboardBottom{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .testimonialStats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
    .card{min-height:200px;padding:24px 20px;}
  }

    .hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px, 10vw, 52px);letter-spacing:-1px;}

    .hero p{font-size:16px;max-width:100%;}

    .dashboardCards{padding:16px;gap:16px;}

    .pricingCards,.testimonialCards,.securityCards,.industryGrid,.featuresGrid,.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr;}

    .carouselArrow{width:40px;height:40px;}
    .card{padding:20px 16px;min-height:180px;}

    .floatingWhatsapp{bottom:16px;right:16px;width:52px;height:52px;}
    .securityCards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .securityCard{padding:20px 16px;}
    .securityBar{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;padding:20px;}
    .barItem{text-align:center;}
    .combinedInner{gap:20px;}

    .stats{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;}
    .note{padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;}
  }

  let activeIndex = 0;
  const n = whyCards.length;
  function renderCarousel() {
    cardEls.forEach((el, i) => {
      let diff = i - activeIndex;
      if (diff > n / 2) diff -= n;
      if (diff < -n / 2) diff += n;
      el.className = el.className.replace(/pos--?\d|pos-hidden/g, '').trim();
      if (diff === 0) el.classList.add('pos-0');
      else if (diff === -1) el.classList.add('pos--1');
      else if (diff === 1) el.classList.add('pos-1');
      else if (diff === -2) el.classList.add('pos--2');
      else if (diff === 2) el.classList.add('pos-2');
      else el.classList.add('pos-hidden');
    });
    dotEls.forEach((d, i) => d.classList.toggle('active', i === activeIndex));
  }
  renderCarousel();

  let autoTimer;
  function startAutoScroll() {
    clearInterval(autoTimer);
    autoTimer = setInterval(() => {
      activeIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % n;
      renderCarousel();
    }, 6000);
  }
  function resetAutoScroll() {
    clearInterval(autoTimer);
    startAutoScroll();
  }
  document.getElementById('carouselPrev').addEventListener('click', () => {
    activeIndex = (activeIndex - 1 + n) % n;
    renderCarousel();
    resetAutoScroll();
  });

  async function updateDashboard() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://www.promeet.zodopt.com/home/reports');
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();

      /* Visit Status card */
      const total = data.totalVisits ?? data.visitStatus?.total ?? 6;
      const co = data.checkedOut ?? data.visitStatus?.checkedOut ?? 3;
      const aco = data.autoCheckedOut ?? data.visitStatus?.autoCheckedOut ?? 3;
      const coPct = total > 0 ? Math.round((co / total) * 100) : 50;
      const acoPct = 100 - coPct;
      const circ = 2 * Math.PI * 40;
      const acoLen = Math.round((aco / total) * circ);
      const coLen = Math.round((co / total) * circ);

      const visitStatus = document.querySelector('.dashCard.visitStatus');
      if (visitStatus) {
        const circles = visitStatus.querySelectorAll('svg circle');
        if (circles.length >= 2) {
          circles[0].setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', `${acoLen} ${circ}`);
          circles[1].setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', `${coLen} ${circ}`);
          circles[1].setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', `-${acoLen}`);
        }
        const center = visitStatus.querySelector('.donutCenter strong');
        if (center) center.textContent = total;

        const rows = visitStatus.querySelectorAll('.visitLegendRow');
        if (rows.length >= 2) {
          rows[0].querySelector('.visitCount').textContent = aco;
          rows[0].querySelector('.visitPct').textContent = `${acoPct}%`;
          rows[1].querySelector('.visitCount').textContent = co;
          rows[1].querySelector('.visitPct').textContent = `${coPct}%`;
        }
        const segs = visitStatus.querySelectorAll('.visitBar span');
        if (segs.length >= 2) {
          segs[0].style.width = `${acoPct}%`;
          segs[1].style.width = `${coPct}%`;
        }
      }

      /* Peak Check-in Hours card */
      const peak = data.peakHours ?? data.hourlyDistribution ?? data.hourlyVisits;
      if (Array.isArray(peak) && peak.length > 0) {
        const bars = document.querySelectorAll('.peakBars span');
        const maxVal = Math.max(...peak, 1);
        bars.forEach((bar, i) => {
          const val = i < peak.length ? peak[i] : 0;
          const pct = Math.round((val / maxVal) * 100);
          bar.style.height = `${pct}%`;
          bar.className = pct >= 80 ? 'peak' : pct >= 55 ? 'peakMed' : '';
        });
      }

      /* Live Dashboard stats */
      if (data.todayVisitors != null) {
        const el = document.getElementById('todayVisitors');
        if (el) el.textContent = data.todayVisitors;
      }
      if (data.activeMeetings != null) {
        const el = document.getElementById('activeMeetings');
        if (el) el.textContent = data.activeMeetings;
      }
    } catch (_) { /* silent fallback */ }
  }

  updateDashboard();
  setInterval(updateDashboard, 30000);

  /* ── Hamburger Menu ──────────────────────────────── */
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  if (hamburger && mobileNav) {
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = mobileNav.classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
    });
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburger.classList.remove('active');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });
  }
</script>

</body>
</html>
